result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: truncated text on the right-edge restaurant card, misaligned card heights in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, and a partially cut-off category chip. Overall 4 issues found (2 major, 2 minor).

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) has a larger image and sits lower than the adjacent cards (Green Bowl Poké, Trattoria Piccol...), causing uneven vertical alignment of images, titles, and delivery prices across the row.
issues.suggestion: Standardize card image dimensions and use consistent top alignment so all carousel cards share the same height and baseline for titles and prices.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' on the right edge is clipped by the screen boundary with no visible ellipsis or clear peek affordance, making the name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with an ellipsis within the card width, or adjust carousel item widths/peek amount so partially visible cards clearly indicate horizontal scrollability without cutting text awkwardly.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge showing only a small sliver, which looks like a rendering artifact rather than an intentional scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Increase the visible peek of the next chip (e.g., show ~30–40% of it) or add a subtle edge fade to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom ('−20%') is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, with its title and details hidden, and the nav bar lacks a clear separator/shadow over the content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the nav bar height and/or a top border or shadow on the bottom navigation so clipped content reads as scrollable rather than broken.
